messages:
Marta (People Ops): Quick thread from the all-hands Q&A about hybrid work, travel approvals, and family travel support. Posting answers and next steps here.
Leo (Facilities): Are we still limiting hoteling to 3 days/week per person? People asked.
Marta (People Ops): No limit company-wide. We ask teams to be considerate during peak days. Facilities will add a "peak" warning in the booking UI.
Ivy (Recruiting): If a candidate is remote-first but needs to visit HQ for onboarding, who covers that travel?
Marta (People Ops): Company covers first-time onboarding travel for remote hires (flight + 2 nights). Hiring team books via travel@redwood.
Nikhil (Eng): For teams with on-call that require on-site access, can we get travel support for last-minute trips?
travel-helper-bot: Policy: emergency ops travel eligible for expedited booking and same-day hoteling; manager approval required within 48 hours post-trip.
Sara (Legal): Question re: visa support for employees invited to international offsites  is Redwood handling visa letters?
Marta (People Ops): Yes, People Ops will provide invitation letters and coordinate visa reimbursements for necessary visa fees. Submit request at people_ops@redwood at least 4 weeks prior.
Ivy (Recruiting): Any dependent-care support when employees travel for mandatory on-site weeks?
Marta (People Ops): We offer dependent-care reimbursement up to $150/day with pre-approval for documented childcare or eldercare. Attach receipts in Expensify.
Nikhil (Eng): Can teams request extra headcount at HQ for week-long collabs? Any budget?
Marta (People Ops): Teams can request a "collab-week" stipend (up to $800 per team) for space, snacks, and local travel. Submit the quick form on the handbook. Managers sign off.
Leo (Facilities): FYI: starting May 15 we'll add a "business-travel" reservation tag and enforce 4-hour hold window before no-show release.
Marta (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops to post visa letter template + process by Apr 20; 2) Facilities to add travel tag + no-show policy by May 15; 3) Finance to confirm dependent-care category in Expensify by Apr 25.
Ivy (Recruiting): Thanks, will update job descriptions about onboarding visit coverage.
Nikhil (Eng): Super helpful.
Marta (People Ops): Please DM me if you have special cases. I'll update this thread when each item is done. Thanks :raised_hands:
